name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main, staging]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  quality:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 12
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38

name: Course contract compatibility

# Unfiltered by path: the check compares this repository's released contract
# against Course's vendored copy, so a change on either side — including one that
# touches no path listed here — can break it. Path filters meant a change to
# Course's vendored copy alone triggered no verification in either repository.
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      course_ref:
        description: Course API ref to verify
        required: false
        default: main

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  compatibility:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
